description: Feature set R. R_U = unit|contract with non-empty tests. R_manual = R \ R_U. Same schema as mcp_guard.

requirements.title: Device wire: one session, one in-flight message
requirements.acceptance: Device opens wss .../session with device_token, sends hello, receives welcome then one message at a time, and acks on the same socket. A dropped socket requeues the unacked message. GET /pending remains for firmware that has not connected the session.

requirements.title: Control plane queues invoke; device runs whitelist tools
requirements.acceptance: POST /api/invoke with oct_ token enqueues invoke message; device executes only tools present in its compiled capabilities

requirements.title: Hot-deploy Lua once/loop without reflashed firmware
requirements.acceptance: POST /api/scripts deploys source; device runs on_start/on_loop; /api/script/stop ends loop; emit() reaches GET /api/events

requirements.title: Signed Lua survives reboot on a LittleFS partition
requirements.acceptance: partitions_16MB.csv adds a 128KB littlefs data partition beside dual OTA slots without moving the spiffs ML cache; partitions_4MB.csv does the same beside the 3MB app slot; deploy signs an LCLW envelope with Ed25519; the device verifies the signature before writing, uses a .tmp read-back and rename, keeps 3 versions, reloads the newest valid script at boot, rolls back when a version fails, and enters safe mode when none remain; OTA app slots do not overlap littlefs; stop clears the run flag; missing signing key is 503

requirements.title: Multi-tenant device register and rotate token
requirements.acceptance: Owner binds device_id; device_token returned once; rotate invalidates old bearer; agents never see user password

requirements.title: Wi-Fi provisioning via AP portal / stored NVS
requirements.acceptance: Empty NVS opens OC-Setup portal; successful STA stores SSID; safe_upload keeps NVS tokens

requirements.title: PanelDisplay abstracts RLCD, ePaper, and planned AMOLED 1.75C
requirements.acceptance: pio env selects BOARD_PANEL_*; Lua gfx.W/H match compiled size; flush/showGxBitmap work on 1bpp panels; slowPanel true on e-ink; AMOLED env (when built) reports 466x466 and slowPanel false

requirements.title: Lua gfx.* draws on active PanelDisplay
requirements.acceptance: clear/pixel/line/rect/circle/text/blit/flush/qr behave; demos layout via gfx.W/H not hard-coded single size; color 0/1 remains valid on all panel products

requirements.title: Color/round Lua gfx extensions for AMOLED badge
requirements.acceptance: On amoled-175c: gfx.color true, gfx.bpp 16, gfx.rgb/palette, gfx.shape round, gfx.safe_r/in_round/polar; 0/1 draws map via palette; full RGB frames only via gfx.image; contract in AMOLED-175C-PRODUCT.md; CO5300 driver may lag the API docs

requirements.title: Lua input.touch and on_touch behind capability touch
requirements.acceptance: Products with touch report capability touch; input.touch returns nil or {x,y,pressed}; on_touch(x,y,phase) gets down/move/up; absent capability omits APIs; control plane docs list them under touch only

requirements.title: Product env for Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C
requirements.acceptance: Env esp32-s3-amoled-175c links panel+audio+sensors+ml (no arm/TTS/BLE); product=amoled-175c; pin map in board_pins; CO5300 stub until QSPI driver; sole public web-flash CI SKU via web-flash-amoled.yml

requirements.title: Browser Web Serial flash for product firmwares
requirements.acceptance: GET /flash serves the installer UI; GET /api/firmware lists products with ready flags; each ready product exposes an ESP Web Tools manifest and bin parts under /firmware/<id>/; Chrome/Edge over HTTPS or localhost; packaging script copies PlatformIO artifacts without committing bins

requirements.title: Audio plugin beep and PCM on boards with ES8311
requirements.acceptance: invoke beep / Lua audio.beep and play_pcm work on RLCD; product without codec omits audio plugin

requirements.title: BLE + LAN HTTP pad share direction state
requirements.acceptance: http://device-ip/ pad and BLE Claude-OC-* expose ble.dir(); ePaper product may compile without BLE

requirements.title: Sensors read for status and Lua
requirements.acceptance: sensors() / sensors.read expose available temp/humidity/battery fields without crashing when ADC/PMU missing; ePaper reads the TG28 (AXP2101) fuel gauge when present

requirements.title: Panel shows battery level by default
requirements.acceptance: Every flush overlays a top-right badge (icon + pct, '+' when charging, 'USB' when sensed but no cell); boards that cannot sense battery show nothing; Lua gfx.badge(false) hides it until the next script load

requirements.title: Claude desktop Hardware Buddy over BLE
requirements.acceptance: BLE builds advertise Claude-OC-* with Nordic UART; heartbeat/turn/time update state; status/name/owner/unpair acked, folder push declined; permission prompt card (KEY allow, BOOT deny) pauses Lua and restores the screen; LE Secure passkey shown on panel; Lua claude.state/allow/deny/takeover

requirements.title: Server renders and pushes panel-sized bitmaps
requirements.acceptance: POST /api/push|/push/image uses device panel size from registry; device shows frame via PanelDisplay

requirements.title: Device reports capabilities[]; control plane filters tools
requirements.acceptance: /status meta.capabilities lists compiled plugins; invoke of absent tool is rejected server-side or no-oped on device; agent docs reflect per-device map

requirements.title: PlatformIO envs compile capability subsets
requirements.acceptance: Panel envs exclude arm sources; RoArm env excludes panel/audio/gfx registration; binary size and Lua global table match product

requirements.title: Motor passthrough invoke reaches servos without Lua
requirements.acceptance: Authenticated arm.move/stream/feedback/stop (or equivalent) drive joints under software limits; does not require a deployed script; concurrent Lua motion yields to stop/passthrough lock

requirements.title: Lua arm.* for slow orchestration on RoArm product
requirements.acceptance: Deployed Lua can read joints and command poses via arm.*; panel product firmware does not expose arm.*

requirements.title: No anonymous local joint control on RoArm product
requirements.acceptance: Factory-style open AP /js JSON control is disabled or token-gated; only device_token cloud path and authenticated local debug control joints

requirements.title: Host vision pathway detects objects from a frame
requirements.acceptance: Given a BGR/JPEG frame, vision pipeline returns SceneDesc.objects with normalized u,v,span,kind; runs on host only (not ESP firmware)

requirements.title: Host vision pathway reports empty-space regions
requirements.acceptance: SceneDesc.empties lists free-space regions with where/area after object occupancy masking

requirements.title: Compact one-line state for text judges
requirements.acceptance: SceneDesc.state is a single line encoding objects + empties (no raw image bytes); suitable as JEV/Agent state

requirements.title: Vision is pathway B — not RoArm/panel firmware
requirements.acceptance: esp32-roarm-m2 and panel envs do not link vision models; VISION-PATHWAY.md and ADR 0003 document separation; Agent may bridge pathways

requirements.title: Slow JEV decision tick with history window
requirements.acceptance: Host loop runs at T_dec (slow; JEV-bound); each tick loads goal+scene+mech+q_all+hist(W); records DecisionTick for replay

requirements.title: Per-joint action is a safe angle interval
requirements.acceptance: JEV choice maps to [lo,hi] within limits, width>=w_min, |mid-q|<=Δ_max; q already in range means hold; success if end q in interval

requirements.title: Independent parallel JEV judge per servo
requirements.acceptance: One JEV choice call per joint per tick, shared state text, joint-specific instructions; calls issued in parallel

requirements.title: Cloud carries goals not trajectories
requirements.acceptance: At most one arm.stream(q*,spd) per tick via cloud invoke; no dense cloud waypoint interpolation; inter-tick motion is servo spd or future ESP T_move

requirements.title: JEV servo is pathway C — not ESP firmware
requirements.acceptance: No JEV client or vision models in esp32-roarm-m2; JEV-SERVO-PATHWAY.md and ADR 0004; may consume vision state and arm invoke only

requirements.title: Tip-cam YuNet face → binary presence (+u,v for follow)
requirements.acceptance: presence_from_scene parses face@u,v; ignores COCO person alone; present bool is mission input

requirements.title: Joint-space raise then j0 sweep while missing
requirements.acceptance: TraversePlanner raises pitch then steps j0 with visited coverage; no FK look_az authority; PRESENCE-FOLLOW-PATHWAY.md

requirements.title: Follow keeps face in frame; miss streak returns to traverse
requirements.acceptance: On present: UV heuristic δq; on miss_limit: back to traverse; mode=presence loop does not require JEV

requirements.title: Persistent face#id gallery with auto-enroll
requirements.acceptance: Unknown faces get new integer ids saved under face_gallery/; rematch reuses id; faces list/rename CLI; state shows face#id

requirements.title: Uploaded models are checked against the firmware op set
requirements.acceptance: POST /api/ml/models parses the .tflite flatbuffer and rejects (422) any builtin or custom op outside op set v1; server ml_opset.py and firmware registerOpsetV1() list the same ops; malformed files only raise TfliteError

requirements.title: Model manifests are signed; devices fetch envelope + blob
requirements.acceptance: Manifest bytes signed with ECDSA P-256 (openssl); GET /api/v1/device/{id}/models/{name} returns {manifest, sig} for the device owner's models only; /blob returns the bytes with Content-Length; version increments per upload; audio models require their frontend first; 503 without a key

requirements.title: Firmware validates model manifests
requirements.acceptance: ml_manifest.cpp accepts the server-built micro_speech manifest; rejects bad name/kind/sha256/bytes/arena, opset newer than firmware, non-16 kHz audio, clips over 10 s, self-referencing frontend

requirements.title: Device downloads, verifies, caches and runs models from Lua
requirements.acceptance: ml.load verifies the signature against OC_ML_PUBKEY_PEM and the blob sha256, caches both on LittleFS (works offline after first load), builds a PSRAM interpreter; ml.listen records one clip, runs the frontend per frame and the classifier; ml.run takes a float table; results {label, index, score, scores, ms}; /status meta.ml lists loaded models; capability 'ml' on S3 builds only

requirements.title: Keyword spotting (micro_speech yes/no) delivered as data
requirements.acceptance: Upload ml/models/micro_speech (frontend + classifier) without reflashing; a Lua script on the RLCD shows and emits 'yes' / 'no' when spoken

requirements.title: Chinese child TTS, girl and boy pitch, on codec boards
requirements.acceptance: audio.say and invoke say speak Chinese; girl/童女 higher and shorter than boy/童男; boot says 我是童女 then 我是童男 on RLCD; boards without the codec omit it
